description: This file defines a Java interface named PermissionDao, which provides data access methods for Permission entities, including listing permissions, retrieving by ID, filtering by groups, and listing by criteria.

classes.name: PermissionDao
classes.description: A Java interface that extends SalesManagerEntityDao to provide data access operations specific to Permission entities.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Returns a list of all permissions.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Permission object by its unique ID.

methods.name: getPermissionsListByGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of permissions associated with the specified set of permission IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Returns a list of permissions matching the provided criteria.
